title: Clinic Information Desk: Clear Health Habits
instructions: 这是模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。先听录音（可读 transcript），注意 because / so、should 和比较级/最高级。然后做 8 道听力题。之后学习语法规则并做 8 道语法题。最后完成口语和写作练习。所有题目和选项用英语，解释用中文。
transcript:
Nurse: Good morning. This is the Green Street Clinic information desk. How can I help you?
Patient: Hi. I feel tired every day. I sleep only five hours. What should I do?
Nurse: You should sleep seven or eight hours. Sleep is very important because your body needs rest.
Patient: OK. And I drink two cups of coffee at night. Is that bad?
Nurse: Yes. Coffee at night is bad for sleep. You should not drink coffee after six o'clock.
Patient: I see. I also eat a big dinner very late. Is that a problem?
Nurse: Yes, it is. A big late dinner is not good because your stomach needs time to rest.
Patient: So I should eat dinner early?
Nurse: Yes. Eat dinner before seven o'clock. And walk for twenty minutes after dinner. Walking is good for your health.
Patient: My friend says running is better than walking. Is that true?
Nurse: Running is faster, but walking is safer for you. Walking is the best exercise for a beginner.
Patient: OK. I have one more question. I work on my computer for ten hours. My back hurts.
Nurse: You should stand up every hour. Stand up and move for five minutes. This is very important because long sitting is bad for your back.
Patient: Thank you. Can I get a paper about this?
Nurse: Yes. Here is our new patient paper. It says: sleep eight hours, no coffee at night, dinner before seven, walk every day, and stand up every hour. Please read it at home.
Patient: Great. I will read it tonight. Thank you very much.
Nurse: You're welcome. Goodbye.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示“因为”，后面接原因；so 表示“所以”，后面接结果。should 表示“应该”，后面接动词原形，否定是 should not + 动词原形。比较级用于两者比较：短形容词加 -er，如 faster, safer；最高级用于三者或以上比较：短形容词加 -est，前面常加 the，如 the best。注意 good 的比较级是 better，最高级是 the best。
grammar.example: Sleep is very important because your body needs rest.

questions.prompt: I am tired ______ I sleep only five hours.
questions.explanation: “我累”是结果，“我只睡五小时”是原因，所以用 because 引导原因。
questions.evidence: I am tired because I sleep only five hours.

questions.prompt: You ______ drink coffee at night. It is bad for sleep.
questions.explanation: 咖啡对睡眠不好，所以建议“不应该”喝，用 should not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: You should not drink coffee at night.

questions.prompt: Walking is ______ than running for a beginner.
questions.explanation: 句中有 than，表示两者比较，用比较级 safer。
questions.evidence: Running is faster, but walking is safer for you.

questions.prompt: Walking is ______ exercise for a beginner.
questions.explanation: 三者或以上比较用最高级，good 的最高级是 the best。
questions.evidence: Walking is the best exercise for a beginner.

questions.prompt: My back hurts ______ I sit for ten hours.
questions.explanation: “背疼”是结果，“坐十小时”是原因，用 because。
questions.evidence: I work on my computer for ten hours. My back hurts.

questions.prompt: You ______ stand up every hour. It is good for your back.
questions.explanation: 站起来对背好，所以建议“应该”做，用 should + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: You should stand up every hour.

questions.explanation: 有 than，两者比较，fast 的比较级是 faster。
questions.evidence: Running is faster, but walking is safer for you.

questions.prompt: I sleep only five hours, ______ I feel tired every day.
questions.explanation: “只睡五小时”是原因，“每天累”是结果，用 so 引导结果。
questions.evidence: I feel tired every day. I sleep only five hours.
